# Anoop Singh
> Anoop Singh is a Senior Software Engineer and Drupal Specialist with 13+ years of experience specializing in front-end architecture, responsive UI/UX, decoupled CMS implementations, and custom Drupal theming (Drupal 7 – 11).

## Professional Overview
- **Role**: Senior Software Engineer at NextOpcode Consulting LLP
- **Expertise**: Custom Drupal 10/11 Theming, Decoupled Next.js Architectures, React, TypeScript, and Full-Stack Web Engineering.
- **Location**: Jaipur, India (Remote-friendly worldwide)
